newsitem.title: USA: Cisco realigns to focus on customer units.
newsitem.headline: Cisco realigns to focus on customer units.

text.p: Cisco Systems Inc said Wednesday it was realigning its organization to focus on customer segments as part of an effort to switch from a product-focused structure to a customer-oriented structure.
The company said all its research-and-development and solutions marketing will be organized under three lines of business -- service provider, enterprise and small/medium business.

It said its service provider organization will provide end-to-end networking systems for service provider customers, including telecommunication carriers, Internet service providers, cable and wireless companies.
The enterprise group will serve large corporate and institutional customers, and the small/medium business group will deliver networking solutions for small to medium-sized customers.

"This alignment will enable us to bring increased focus to our customers and provide them with complete end-to-end solutions, including integrated software, hardware and network management," the company said in a statement.
